game.title: Dice sum
game.description:
Two dice are rolled independently. Repeated numbers are separate faces.
- Die 1 (4 faces, each equally likely): 7, 9, 10, 11.
- Die 2 (6 faces, each equally likely): 7, 7, 8, 10, 10, 11.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of all the dice.

game.title: Dice/cards range
game.description:
Two dice are rolled independently. Repeated numbers are separate faces.
- Die 1 (8 faces, each equally likely): 0, 0, 1, 4, 4, 9, 9, 9.
- Die 2 (8 faces, loaded): 2 (prob 1/10), 3 (prob 1/10), 4 (prob 3/10), 6 (prob 1/10), 7 (prob 1/10), 8 (prob 1/10), 8 (prob 1/10), 9 (prob 1/10).
game.contract: The contract settles at the largest minus the smallest of the dice.

game.title: Card sum
game.description: A custom deck of 16 cards is shuffled: 4 cards worth 0, 3 cards worth 1, 1 card worth 3, 1 card worth 4, 1 card worth 6, 2 cards worth 9, 4 cards worth 13. 3 cards are dealt face down, without replacement.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of the dealt cards' values.

game.title: Dice sum
game.description:
Four dice are rolled independently. Repeated numbers are separate faces.
- Die 1 (4 faces, loaded): 3 (prob 1/5), 4 (prob 1/10), 6 (prob 2/5), 12 (prob 3/10).
- Die 2 (8 faces, each equally likely): 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 10, 11, 12.
- Die 3 (6 faces, each equally likely): 1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 10.
- Die 4 (6 faces, each equally likely): 0, 0, 1, 2, 9, 10.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of all the dice.

game.title: Coin of unknown bias
game.description: A coin is picked at random from a set of coins: P(heads) = 0.1 with probability 1/2, P(heads) = 0.5 with probability 1/2. The coin is not shown. It is flipped 8 times. Revealed flips show 1 for heads and 0 for tails.
game.contract: The contract settles at 5 times the number of heads in all flips.

game.title: Dice sum
game.description:
Three dice are rolled independently. Repeated numbers are separate faces.
- Die 1 (8 faces, each equally likely): 3, 3, 6, 7, 7, 9, 10, 12.
- Die 2 (4 faces, loaded): 1 (prob 1/10), 1 (prob 1/2), 8 (prob 1/5), 8 (prob 1/5).
- Die 3 (4 faces, each equally likely): 2, 2, 7, 10.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of all the dice.

game.title: Card sum
game.description: A custom deck of 11 cards is shuffled: 1 card worth 1, 4 cards worth 3, 2 cards worth 7, 4 cards worth 10. 3 cards are dealt face down, without replacement.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of the dealt cards' values.

game.title: Urn of unknown mix
game.description: An urn holds 10 balls, each red or blue. Each ball was independently painted red with probability 0.6. 3 balls are drawn without replacement. Revealed draws show 1 for red and 0 for blue.
game.contract: The contract settles at 10 times the number of red balls originally in the urn.

game.title: Card sum
game.description: A custom deck of 13 cards is shuffled: 3 cards worth 1, 2 cards worth 6, 4 cards worth 9, 4 cards worth 12. 2 cards are dealt face down, without replacement.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of the dealt cards' values.

game.title: Urn of unknown mix
game.description: An urn holds 10 balls, each red or blue. Each ball was independently painted red with probability 0.5. 2 balls are drawn without replacement. Revealed draws show 1 for red and 0 for blue.
game.contract: The contract settles at the number of red balls originally in the urn.

game.title: Coin of unknown bias
game.description: A coin is picked at random from a set of coins: P(heads) = 0.2 with probability 1/2, P(heads) = 0.5 with probability 1/2. The coin is not shown. It is flipped 5 times. Revealed flips show 1 for heads and 0 for tails.
game.contract: The contract settles at the number of heads in all flips.

game.title: Dice/cards max
game.description:
Three dice are rolled independently. Repeated numbers are separate faces.
- Die 1 (4 faces, each equally likely): 0, 0, 3, 10.
- Die 2 (6 faces, each equally likely): 0, 5, 7, 10, 11, 11.
- Die 3 (8 faces, each equally likely): 0, 1, 4, 5, 7, 8, 11, 12.
game.contract: The contract settles at the largest of the dice.
